paite: Nou siampute aw, hiai ja uh, nou Israel inkote, ngaikhia un, kumpipa inkote aw, bil doh un, vaihawmna lah na tung ua hongtung ding ahi ngala; Mizpaha thang leh, Tabor tunga len phah na nahikhinta ngal ua.
english: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

paite: Mithahna lamah mihelte thukpi a paita ua; himahleh amaute tengteng taipa ka hi.
english: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I discipline all of them.

paite: Ephraim ka theia, Israel ka lakah selin a om kei; Ephraim aw, tuin lah, kijuakin na omta ngala, Israel a buahta hi.
english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

paite: A thilbawlte un a Pathian uh kianglam uh a ngasak sin kei hi8; a sung uah lah kijuakna kha a om ngala, TOUPA a theikei uhi.
english: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God; for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know Yahweh.

paite: Israel kisaktheihnain a maah a theihpih a; huaijiakin Israel leh Ephraim a thulimlouhna uah a kisui ding hi.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

paite: TOUPA zong dingin a bawnghonte uh leh a belamhonte utoh a kuan ding ua; himahleh amah a mu kei ding uh; amau akipanin a kihem khe-ta hi.
english: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahweh; but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

paite: TOUPA tungah lepchiahtakin a gamta ua; ta lamdangte a nei ngal ua; tuin a loute uh toh kha thakin amau a negai ding hi.
english: They are unfaithful to Yahweh; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

paite: Gibeah ah na pengkulbinei uh mut inla, Rama ah pengkul; Beth-aven ah, na nung ah; Aw Benjamin, authawngna gingsak un.
english: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

paite: Tai niin Ephraim a hongsegawp sing a; a hongom ngeingei ding Israel namte lakah ka theisakta hi.
english: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

paite: Juda lalte gamchiamtehna lamangte hi uh; tuibangin ka hehna a tunguah ka sungbo ding.
english: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

paite: Epraim nuaisiahin a om, vaihawmna ah delkhumin a om hi, thupiak juia om a lungkim jiakin.
english: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; Because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

paite: Huaijiakin Ephraim adingin puannget bang ka hi a, Juda inkote adingin siatna bang.
english: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

paite: Ephraimin a chinatna a muha, Juda in a liamna a muh chiangin, huai chiangin Ephraim bel Assuria kiangah a hohtaa kumpipa Jareb kiangah a sawlta hi; himahleh nang a hon hihdam theikeia, na luamna leng a hondam thei sam kei hi.
english: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

paite: Ephraim adinga humpinelkai bang leh, Juda inkote adia humpinelkai tuailai bang ka hih jiakin; Kei, kei mahmahin, ka botnen dia ka pai mang ding; ka po mang dinga; honkhe ding kuamah a om kei ding hi.A tatkhelhna uh thupha a tawi ua, ka mel a zon ma siah uh, ka pai dia ka munah ka kik nawn ding; a ginthuakna uah chihtaktakin kei a honzong ding uh.
english: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

paite: A tatkhelhna uh thupha a tawi ua, ka mel a zon ma siah uh, ka pai dia ka munah ka kik nawn ding; a ginthuakna uah chihtaktakin kei a honzong ding uh.
english: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
